data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Every stock movement, newest first. Movements are never edited: a mistake is corrected with a reversal.

data.name: ReversalConfirmText
data.value: Movement {0} stays in the history; a new reversal movement cancels its stock effect. This cannot be undone.

data.name: ReversedInSource
data.value: Posted by another module: it is reversed in that module.

data.name: NamesUnavailable
data.value: Product and location names could not be loaded right now, so codes are shown instead. The stock figures are correct.

data.name: PickerUnavailable
data.value: This list is not available right now (the master data service cannot be reached). You can still filter by the other fields.

data.name: ErrInsufficientStock
data.value: There is not enough stock at the source for this movement. Nothing was changed; check the available quantity and try again.

data.name: ErrAlreadyReversed
data.value: This movement has already been reversed. Nothing was changed; reload the list to see the reversal.

data.name: ErrMasterUnavailable
data.value: Product or location data cannot be checked right now, so no change was made. Try again when the connection is back.

data.name: ErrCrossLegalEntity
data.value: This record belongs to another company. Switch to that company or ask your administrator for access.

data.name: ErrKeyReused
data.value: This action was already submitted with other values. Close the dialog and start again.

data.name: ErrInvalidRequest
data.value: The request could not be processed because a value is not valid. Reload the page and try again.

data.name: ErrUnknownItem
data.value: The product or SKU is not recognised by the product master. Nothing was changed; check the product.

data.name: ErrUnknownLocation
data.value: The warehouse or location is not recognised. Nothing was changed; check the location.

data.name: ErrUomMissing
data.value: This unit cannot be converted to the base unit of the SKU. Nothing was changed; choose another unit.

data.name: ErrLotRequired
data.value: This product is lot-controlled: a lot is required. Nothing was changed; enter the lot and try again.

data.name: ErrSerialMismatch
data.value: The number of serial numbers does not match the quantity. Nothing was changed; correct the serial numbers.

data.name: ErrConflict
data.value: The data changed while you were working. Reload the list and try again.

data.name: ErrNoPermission
data.value: You do not have access to this action. Ask your administrator for the stock permissions you need.

data.name: ErrSessionExpired
data.value: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

data.name: ErrServiceUnavailable
data.value: The stock service cannot be reached right now. No change was made; try again in a moment.

data.name: ErrGeneric
data.value: Something went wrong and no change was made. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.

data.name: CompanySelectHint
data.value: Select the company whose stock you want to see. Nothing is shown until a company is selected.

data.name: CompanyUnavailable
data.value: The company list could not be loaded, so no stock data is shown. Ask your administrator for permission to view companies, or try again later.

data.name: ErrSelectCompany
data.value: Select a company first. Nothing was read or changed.

data.name: ErrCompanyCheckUnavailable
data.value: The selected company cannot be confirmed right now, so no change was made. Try again in a moment.

data.name: OriginalMissingTitle
data.value: Open the correction from the movement history

data.name: OriginalMissingText
data.value: This page corrects one movement from the history. Use “Correct” on a manual movement in the movement history; automatic movements are corrected in the module that posted them.

data.name: PartialText
data.value: Reversal {0} has been posted, but the corrected movement was not: {1}

data.name: PartialHint
data.value: The original movement is already cancelled by the reversal. Fix the field below and post the corrected movement; the same request is reused, so nothing is posted twice.
